As a new user, I want to register an account with my email and password, so that I can access the platform.

Summary: US-02 Mandatory 2FA setup on first login
Description: As a registered user, I want to be required to set up two-factor authentication on my first login, so that my account can't be protected by a password alone.

Summary: US-03 Account lockout after failed logins
Description: As a user, I want my account to lock for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts, so that attackers can't brute-force my password.

Summary: US-04 Password reset via single-use token
Description: As a user who forgot my password, I want to request a reset link and set a new password, so that I can regain access without contacting an admin.
As an Administrator, I want to deactivate or reactivate a user account, so that I can immediately revoke access for someone who has left or is under review.

Summary: US-05 Define Roles Resources and Permissions
Description: As an Administrator, I want to define Roles, Resources, and Permissions, so that I can model the organization's access-control policy.

Summary: US-06 Assign or change a user's Role
Description: As an Administrator, I want to assign or change a user's Role, so that their access reflects their current job function.

Summary: US-07 Block privilege-escalation on role assignment
Description: As the system, I want to block a role assignment if the acting admin tries to change their own role or grant Admin without already being an Admin, so that the role-assignment feature can never be used to self-escalate.
As a Standard User, I want to browse available permissions and submit an access request with a justification, so that I can get access to resources I need for my job.
As an Approver, I want to see only the access requests for resources I have approval authority over, so that I'm not shown decisions outside my scope.

Summary: US-10 Approve or reject an access request
Description: As an Approver, I want to approve or reject an access request with an optional note, so that the requester understands the decision and an approval takes effect immediately.
As the system, I want to prevent a user from approving their own access request, so that holding an unrelated approval permission on the same resource can never be used for self-approval.
As an Auditor, I want to view a read-only, paginated log of every security-relevant event, so that I can verify compliance and investigate incidents without being able to alter history.
